title: ImplementationRun Domain-to-ORM Mapper
objective: Implement pure bidirectional ImplementationRun conversion with exact logical repository identity, Enum, UTC datetime, nullable value, Domain-state, safe-error, and ORM-only version semantics.
scope: ImplementationRun Domain-to-new-version-1-record conversion and loaded-record-to-validated-Domain reconstruction.
Five exact Enum fields, aware UTC times, commits, optional hashes, repository paths, workspace flags, logical repository identity, and version boundary.
Run Mapper contract, dedicated tests, bounded Context guards, Project Memory, immutable Run, and one local commit.
explicit_non_goals: No RunRelationship, detail, reference, annotation, artifact-location, ChangedFile/ChangedSymbol identity mapper or function.
No Manifest parsing/binding, repository identity resolver, Git/context lookup, Repository, Session, Unit of Work, database, migration, Parser/Indexer, API, or UI.
No Domain/ORM model/accepted ADR/dependency/lockfile/runtime configuration/Factor Lab/business research/LightGBM/Qlib change and no push.

known_limitations: No RunRelationship, detail, reference, annotation, artifact-location, or ChangedFile/ChangedSymbol technical-ID Mapper exists.
No Manifest binding or repository identity resolver exists; Run Mapper accepts only an already valid logical repository identity.
No production Repository, Session, Unit of Work, database, migration, Parser/Indexer, API, or UI exists.
Run mapping creates new version-1 records only; existing-record update and optimistic concurrency paths are not implemented.
Real PostgreSQL and pinned SQLAlchemy behavior were not tested.
unresolved_questions: How will the future Indexer receive and audit trusted logical repository identity binding?
Where will Mapper and identity algorithm versions be persisted before indexing?
How will the production Repository translate expected-version and immutable conflicts?
rollback_information: Revert the single containing commit. No database, schema, migration, data, API, dependency, lockfile, accepted ADR, business runtime, or Factor Lab rollback is required.
security_impact: Run errors expose only bounded safe metadata and omit arbitrary repository values, full records, file contents, database URLs, source bundles, and secret-like identities; no external input or database was accessed.
data_lineage_impact: No research or database data changed; Run conversion now has deterministic contract-versioned semantics but no durable persistence or Manifest indexing was performed.
